quests.title: The Mystery of Tecoloapan Beach

dialogue.t: The fog on the sea has thickened lately. A worrying sign...
Err... Ah, that depends on what legend you wish to hear, outlander hero...
Two reasons have been given for that floating island and the huge graffiti: One more akin to a story, and the other to a real legend.
Which would you like to hear, outlander warrior?
Hmm, there's always a romantic spin with stories... There, the origin of the graffiti on the foggy floating island is part of The Tale of Qoyllor and Ukuku.
It is said that the girl named Qoyllor left a huge work of graffiti by the beach in order to contact her Father Sun.
Her Father Sun saw the graffiti from the sky and thus whisked her away from the earth... That's sort of how the story goes.
It is said that the unsettling mist was bestowed by the Sun Father upon the people of the surface, as punishment for stealing his daughter's power.
*sigh* Be it legend or story, the rising fog is never a good sign.
Outlander hero... That place is probably fraught with danger, so you must take care not to get too close...
Ah, at last... Were it not for your aid, outlander hero, we might have long been overwhelmed by our pitch-black foe...
...Long ago, the tribespeople here were ensorcelled, enchanted by our enemy, and many Nightsouls became entangled by the Abyss.
At the seal's location, even the power of Night's manifestation is slowly being chipped away... This seal severs all links with the outside world, yes, but with the source of the tribe's faith also.
It must be undone for there to be any fighting chance...
Thank you, outlander hero... The Nightsouls can find their way back to their dream-home, avoiding the blight that grips the Lord of the Night's realm.
Ah, at last, to be able to return to the quietude of Night...

quests.description: As you get closer to the island in the fog, a strange noise can be heard from it — what secret past lies hidden in its depths?
